PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE-1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT AT
2600-2610 NORTH CLARK STREET

The Applicant requests a zoning change for the property located at 2600-2610 North Clark Street
(the “Property”) to amend the previously-approved Type | application from the B3-5
Community Shopping District to the B3-5 Community Shopping District in order to construct a
five (5) story, 58’-0” foot tall, transit-oriented, mixed-use building with forty-eight (48) dwelling
units on the 2" through 5" floors, and ten (10) automobile parking spaces, and forty-eight (48)
bicycle parking spaces, approximately 3,467 square feet of commercial space on the ground floor
and a rooftop deck (the “Project”).

The Property is bordered by North Clark Street to the east, West Wrightwood Avenue to the
south, a public alley to the north, and abuts property zoned RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
to the west.

The Property is along the #22/Clark Street CTA bus route (“Clark Street Bus”), which is a CTA
bus line corridor roadway segment listed on Table 17-17-0400-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance (the “Ordinance”) and, accordingly, is a Transit Served Location. The proposed
development is also subject to the Pedestrian Street Standards of Section 17-3-0500 of the
Ordinance.

approval procedures set forth in Section 17-13-0303-D of the Ordinance:

‘) An administrative adjustment to reduce the required parking spaces from twenty-four
(24) spaces to ten (10) spaces (Section 17-13-1003-EE of the Ordinance);

(0°) (Section 17-13-1101-B of the Ordinance);

®) A variation to reduce the north side setback from the required thirteen and one-half feet
(13.5’) to zero feet (0’) (Section 17-13-1101-B of the Ordinance);

“ A variation to reduce the south side setback from the required thirteen and one-half feet

) A variation to reduce the rear yard setback on floors containing residential units from the
required thirty feet (30’) to the proposed five feet, 10 inches (5’-10”) (Section 17-13-

A variation to reduce the off-street loading berth from the required one (1) space to the
proposed zero (0) spaces (Section 17-13-1101-D of the Ordinance);

&) Variations to reduce the required setback for rooftop enclosures, including: (a) a

and 8.0 inches; and
